observations: White upright single-door refrigerator with a top freezer compartment.
Door is closed in photo 0 and photo 2; open in photo 1 showing wire shelf, crisper drawer, door bins, and freezer ice tray.
Interior shows signs of use including frost in the freezer and stains on shelves and walls.
Oval brand badge on the upper right of the door is visible but illegible in all photos.
Temperature control dial is visible inside the freezer compartment on the right.
Room has tiled floor, window with grille, and dark curtains; watermark reads POSTED ON JIJI LUCKY ARUA OKORO.

identity.kind: single door fridge with top freezer

claims.claim: The fridge is in good condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show visible wear and interior stains; no functional test is shown.
No photo or video shows the fridge powered on, cooling, or the interior light working.

risks.risk: Compressor or cooling system may not work.
risks.proof: Video of the fridge running for at least 30 minutes with the interior cold to the touch, or a thermometer reading inside.
Video showing ice cubes frozen or a frozen item inside the freezer after running.

risks.risk: Door gasket may be torn or not sealing.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the full door gasket with the door closed and a paper slip test.

risks.risk: Power cord or plug may be damaged.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the plug and full length of the power cord.

proof_requests: Video of the fridge plugged in and running with the door open to show the light and compressor sound.
Close-up photo of the door gasket and power plug.
Video after several hours showing the freezer is cold and the fridge interior is cooling.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used single-door fridge with a top freezer; because the seller's claim that it works is unproven, it is priced at its worst case as not working.
